reason: I already have a workshop I have gone to for years and I can talk to the owner face to face. I do not know these partners yet, and a new app with a few partners in Riyadh and Cairo does not give me a reason to hand my car to a stranger and pay through it.
objection: If the film peels or the install is bad, who do I complain to, and will that person still be there when I come back? A written warranty in an app means little to me if I cannot reach a real person.
would_change_my_mind: A partner I already know or trust from my area listed on it, with a clear way to reach a real person and a refund if the work is bad.
